Reliable, well-maintained, and ready for your next adventure!

I’m selling my 2018 Ford F-150 XL with the 3.5L EcoBoost V6 engine and just under 73,000 miles. I originally bought this truck for long-term camper travel, but unfortunately, my plans have changed due to work. Otherwise, I’d happily keep it!

This truck had only one previous owner before me and appears to have been part of a government fleet. It has been a great truck, and significant maintenance was completed by the dealership shortly before I purchased it in May 2026.

🔧 MAJOR RECENT MAINTENANCE

The dealership replaced multiple components before selling me the truck, including:

* Cam phaser set
* Water pump
* Alternator (I replaced this myself and have documentation)
* Thermostat housing
* Spark plugs
* Driver-side valve cover
* Solenoid and wiring assembly
* Gaskets and seals
* Additional related components

This is a substantial amount of recent mechanical work, which is a great advantage for the next owner. The dealership performed the work before the sale, so I don’t have receipts for most of those repairs, but I can explain what I know about the service history.

✅ Under 73,000 miles

✅ 2018 Ford F-150 XL
✅ Only one previous owner
✅ Significant recent maintenance
✅ Off-road tires
✅ Front-end bull bar for a rugged look
✅ Truck-bed toolbox included

The truck comes with the accessories shown in the pictures, including the bed-mounted toolbox, front bull bar, and off-road tires. No need to buy these separately!

I’m not selling because there’s anything wrong with the truck or because I don’t like it. My plans for extended camper travel have simply changed due to work.

If you’re looking for a capable, versatile pickup with relatively low mileage, recent maintenance, and useful accessories already included, this F-150 is worth checking out.
